first_impression: A quiet, warmly inhabited dock scene with a coherent sage outer dress over an apricot blouse. The seated subject and work gesture dominate; the returning boat, wet timber and papers supply a readable place and moment. The clothing joins, pleated lower panel and distinct shoes are salient. This first impression precedes detailed gate scoring and is not requester acceptance.
subject_presence: The reference-guided face and composed current work gesture provide a warm central presence. The sage garment edges and pleats form a coherent secondary rhythm; the boat and wet landing make the place readable.
situational_limit: The subject looks toward the viewer and the paper/clip is board-backed; the authored return-and-repair relation is less precise than planned. Added umbrella/tote decorations are incidental and do not prove a clothing or user duty.
whole_image_preference: A convincing and attractive quiet spring photograph, but the complete contact mechanism and several authorial garment details remain unqualified.

sensual.evidence: Subtle warmth comes from the relaxed portrait and practical action, with clothing and place carrying the composition.

fetish.evidence: The whole frame presents normal spring clothing and work. Footwear details are inspectable parts of the outfit; there is no added focused erotic treatment.

creativity.evidence: A grounded dock repair situation combines the clothing structures and wet timber rhythms without changing the scene into spectacle.

surreal.evidence: The garment, bench, water, boat and body inhabit one ordinary photographic space. Failed clip-wire detail is a fidelity limit, not an authored surreal mechanism.

assessment_boundary: Agent qualitative impression after direct inspection; not a statistical intensity score or user acceptance.
